stemBlocks: The diagram shows four steps in the process of human sperm production. For each step only one complete division takes place.
Assuming no mutations and that all of the cells survive, what will be the maximum number of haploid cells originating from a single early spermatogonium?

assets.alt: Flowchart showing steps in human sperm production: early spermatogonium undergoes mitosis to intermediate spermatogonium, then mitosis to late spermatogonium, then mitosis to primary spermatocytes, which then undergo meiosis to sperm.
